output.explanation: Selects all columns from ESTATES filtered to residential property types (continuous or occasional occupancy), surface area of at least 140 sqm, energy classes A1–C, mobility score of at least 71, and within 3.0 km of the given coordinates. Results are ordered by distance from those coordinates, nearest first.
